name: suppressWarnings
title: Return a value and muffle matching warnings

origin.description: A condition that is returned, rather than raised, is left as it is.

arguments.name: expr
arguments.text: A callable, or a value to return.

origin.details: A raised warning whose class matches is muffled. The check passes the condition object through, which is what the package example does.
